scientific_question: Under a frozen common teacher-forced token trajectory, can the current ArcLLM-vs-llama.cpp request excess be prospectively decomposed into token-GPU execution excess and outside-token-GPU residual excess with sufficient transfer back to CORE-0B to support an Amdahl-gated choice of which region deserves the next core study?

existing_phase_surface.note: llama.h explicitly advises third-party apps to do their own performance measurements; external child wall remains the enclosing clock.

existing_gpu_trace_surface.source_semantics: Vulkan query-pool timestamps around graph operations

W-C.prompt_definition: Exact frozen CORE-0B 256-token W-C prompt: first four tokens [1,133151,133152,152062], then token(i)=1+((104729+7919*i) mod 152063) for i=4..255.

common_trajectory_contract.purpose: Remove autoregressive token-trajectory divergence as a confound in cross-system internal-cost attribution.
common_trajectory_contract.prefill: Both systems consume the exact frozen workload prompt.
common_trajectory_contract.next_input_rule: At each cached-decode step, feed the exact frozen forced_decode_input_tokens entry for that workload, never either system's predicted top-1 token.
common_trajectory_contract.logits_rule: Both systems still compute full logits and perform the same full-vocabulary finite/top-1 scan after each prefill/decode call so host scan cost is not silently removed; predicted top-1 is recorded but not fed back.
common_trajectory_contract.topology_shape_required: 1 prefill + 31 cached decode calls on both systems
common_trajectory_contract.note: CORE-0B remains valid as same-prompt/same-output-length request characterization; this contract exists only because its natural autoregressive output sequences differ across systems and therefore cannot be used for exact internal cross-system attribution.

G_TOKEN_GPU.definition: GPU timestamp duration attributable to token model execution only: prefill plus 31 cached-decode graph executions.
G_TOKEN_GPU.arcllm_measurement: Token-XRay Vulkan timestamp spans using the frozen CORE-0C trace contract.
G_TOKEN_GPU.llama_measurement: Exact pinned llama.cpp GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER Vulkan timestamp totals, qualified as 1 prefill timing block + 31 decode timing blocks.

H_OUTSIDE_TOKEN_GPU.definition: Within the same diagnostic TRACE request: external child wall time minus G_TOKEN_GPU duration.
H_OUTSIDE_TOKEN_GPU.interpretation_limit: Residual is not automatically labeled model-load, setup, CPU orchestration, allocation, I/O or any specific mechanism.

secondary_phase_evidence.purpose: Subdivide H descriptively without changing the two-region primary decomposition.
arcllm: benchmark-only monotonic host timestamps around backend/runtime init
model/GGUF load and tensor materialization boundary
secondary_phase_evidence.qualification_rule: Exact boundary names and nesting must be frozen in implementation preflight. If a boundary cannot be observed without changing canonical execution semantics, report it as unavailable; do not infer it.

collection_design.adjacency_rule: Within each mode, the two systems form an adjacent matched pair before moving to the next mode.

pass_if: Exact model/workload/forced-token identities match the preregistration.
Both systems execute 1 prefill + 31 cached decode calls.
No predicted token is fed back into the decode trajectory.

G1_CONTROL_TOTAL_TRANSFER.metric: Per workload, three adjacent CONTROL ArcLLM/llama external-wall ratios.
pass_if: Median ratio is within a multiplicative factor of 1.5 of the frozen CORE-0B workload pooled median.

G2_TRACE_TRANSFER.metric: Per workload, three adjacent GPU_TRACE ArcLLM/llama external-wall ratios.
pass_if: All three trace-pair total excesses are positive.
TRACE median system ratio is within a multiplicative factor of 1.5 of the corresponding CONTROL median system ratio.

arcllm: Exactly 1 prefill + 31 decode Token-XRay traces per TRACE request.
441/469 physical dispatch geometry and 451 semantic nodes remain valid.
llama: GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER is enabled, CONCURRENT mode is disabled and frequency=1.
Exactly 1 prefill + 31 decode timing groups are parsed per TRACE request.
Every timing group is non-empty and has positive finite total GPU operation time.
The logger remains diagnostic-only because it forces submit/wait.

equations: For each TRACE request: H_system = W_system - G_system.
For each matched TRACE pair: DeltaE = W_arc - W_llama.
Numerically require DeltaE = DeltaG + DeltaH within 1 microsecond absolute arithmetic tolerance after unit conversion.
pass_if: G_system >= 0 and H_system >= 0 for every request.
DeltaE > 0 for all six TRACE matched pairs.
No residual component is clamped or rewritten when negative across systems.

reporting: Per workload report median, min, max and MAD of DeltaE, DeltaG, DeltaH, f_G and f_H.
Negative DeltaG or DeltaH is preserved; never clamp to zero.
Do not merge W-S and W-C before workload-specific adjudication.

amdahl_gate.transfer_requirement: G0 through G4 must all PASS before any Amdahl selection.
region_eligibility: median(f_X) must be > 0 in both workloads.
q_X must be >= 0.10 in both workloads.
At least one workload must have q_X >= 0.20.

single_region_priority_rule.decision: Select exactly one region for the next attribution/subfamily study only if its robust score >= 0.15 and exceeds the other region's robust score by >= 0.05. Otherwise return NO_SINGLE_REGION_PRIORITY.

semantic_mapping_boundary.reason: The primary G/H decomposition needs total token-GPU duration only. llama op names and ArcLLM runtime-family names are preserved independently.
semantic_mapping_boundary.if_G_selected: A successor must prospectively qualify a semantic/op-family alignment before attributing excess to lm_head, FFN, attention or any kernel family.
